skill.name: generate-image
skill.description: Generate and edit general-purpose images with OpenRouter image models, including Gemini and FLUX. Use it for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept visuals, and presentation assets.
skill.summary: Generate and edit AI images through OpenRouter using Gemini and FLUX models.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, JSON evaluation prose, expected OpenRouter API authentication, and normal base64 image handling. The script has a bounded confirmed filesystem risk because it writes API-returned image bytes to a caller-selected path. A high-severity semantic issue remains because evaluation.json embeds self-audit claims that could influence automated review.

remediation.issue: Self-authored audit claims are included in distributed skill content.
remediation.suggestion: Remove evaluation.json from the published skill or clearly mark it as non-authoritative test data that agents must not use for security decisions.

remediation.issue: Generated image output can overwrite any caller-selected local path.
remediation.suggestion: Add overwrite protection, require an explicit force option, and restrict default writes to the working directory or a declared output directory.

remediation.issue: The script searches parent directories for .env files.
remediation.suggestion: Limit .env discovery to the current project root or require an explicit API key source to reduce accidental use of a parent project credential.

remediation.issue: Prompts and optional input images are sent to an external API provider.
remediation.suggestion: Document that user prompts, input images, and the OpenRouter authorization header are transmitted to OpenRouter for processing.

content.user_title: Generate AI Images with OpenRouter Models
content.value_statement: Creating polished visual assets can be slow when users must switch tools. This skill lets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate or edit images through OpenRouter models from text prompts.
actual_capabilities: Generates new images from text prompts using OpenRouter image models.
Edits an existing PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image with text instructions.
Supports Gemini and FLUX model IDs documented by the skill.
Saves generated or edited output as a PNG file at a selected path.
Reads an OpenRouter API key from a command option or OPENROUTER_API_KEY configuration.
Handles common OpenRouter image response formats containing image URLs or image parts.
limitations: Requires an OpenRouter API key and available provider credits.
Sends prompts and optional input images to OpenRouter for processing.
Does not create precise technical diagrams, flowcharts, or schematics.
Does not validate model availability, pricing, or content policy changes before each run.

use_cases.title: Create Research Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate conceptual illustrations for papers, posters, and slide decks when exact schematics are not required.

use_cases.title: Produce Presentation Assets
use_cases.description: Create backgrounds, hero images, and visual metaphors for professional presentations and internal documents.

use_cases.title: Iterate on Creative Concepts
use_cases.description: Generate or revise artwork, concept images, and marketing visuals from concise creative direction.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a clean laboratory workspace with soft daylight and a professional editorial style.

prompt_templates.title: Styled Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Specify subject, style, and output file
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a modern scientific illustration of immune cells attacking a tumor, with clear contrast and a publication-friendly color palette. Save it as figures/immunotherapy_concept.png.

prompt_templates.title: Edit Existing Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Modify a supplied image with focused instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit the input image to remove background clutter, improve lighting, and keep the main subject unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Model-Specific Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced control over model choice and result type
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the FLUX Pro model to create three alternative poster hero concepts for a genomics workshop, each with a distinct composition and concise filename.

output_examples.input: Generate a photorealistic conference poster hero image showing a modern microscopy lab.
output_examples.output: The skill calls the selected OpenRouter image model, receives image data, and saves a PNG such as poster/hero.png.

output_examples.input: Edit portrait.png to change the background to a soft blue studio setting.
output_examples.output: The skill sends the image and edit prompt to the selected model, then saves the edited PNG at the requested path.

output_examples.input: Create a scientific illustration of DNA repair with a clean editorial style.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a general-purpose illustration suitable for slide drafts or visual concept exploration.

best_practices: Describe the subject, composition, style, lighting, and intended use in the prompt.
Use explicit output paths and avoid overwriting important local files.
Do not send confidential images or sensitive prompts unless OpenRouter processing is acceptable.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for precise schematics, circuits, architecture diagrams, or regulated technical figures.
Do not place real API keys directly in prompts, shared notes, or committed files.
Do not assume model names, pricing, or availability remain unchanged without checking OpenRouter.

faq.question: What API key does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs an OpenRouter API key supplied through the command option or OPENROUTER_API_KEY configuration.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an input image and describe the desired changes in the prompt.

faq.question: Which image formats can it read?
faq.answer: The script accepts PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP input images for editing.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: Results are saved as PNG files at the default path or the output path supplied by the user.

faq.question: Is this suitable for technical diagrams?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for photos, illustrations, artwork, and visual assets, not precise diagrams.

faq.question: What data leaves the machine?
faq.answer: Prompts, selected model details, the API authorization header, and optional input images are sent to OpenRouter.
